Apply today and become part of a company that’s building more than just structures – we’re building a great place to work.
?? Contact: Samantha Krollig, HR Manager 08 8570 4208
?? Learn more and apply via our Bowhill Engineering website.


Together we thrive.

ABOUT US:
Mizar Partners Pty Ltd is an Australian professional accounting and business advisory firm with offices in Melbourne and Sydney. We provide accounting, taxation, compliance and business advisory services to individuals, sole traders, small and medium-sized businesses, and corporate clients across a wide range of industries.
Our services include bookkeeping, management accounting, taxation, tax planning, business advisory, cash flow management, SMSF support, entity structure advice, financial reporting and compliance support. We focus on providing practical accounting and taxation solutions to help clients maintain accurate financial records, meet their statutory obligations, understand their financial position and make informed business decisions.
Vacant Position: Senior Accountant 
We are seeking an experienced Accountant to join our senior level service team on a full-time basis. The successful applicant will be responsible for preparing, reviewing, analysing financial and taxation information for clients, assisting with statutory compliance, preparing financial statements and tax returns, supporting business advisory work, and providing professional accounting support across a range of client matters.
This role is suited to a professional with strong technical knowledge in accounting, taxation, financial reporting, business compliance, accounting systems, budget analysis, cash flow management and client advisory services.
Hiring Type: Permanent Full-time
Salary Range: Above AUD82,000 + super/ per year 
(The remuneration will depend on the skills, outcomes and experience you can deliver. )
Working Location: Melbourne
Qualification Requirements:
•	Above Master’s degree from Australia or overseas tertiary education provider is a must;
•	Must have a minimum of 3 years’ relevant accounting experience in public practice or business services.
•	Strong communication skills required, including proficiency in English and Mandarin.
•	Hands-on public practice experience delivering end-to-end tax, BAS and financial reporting services for Australian SME.
•	In-depth working knowledge of ATO legislation, payroll compliance, FBT, GST, PAYG and superannuation regulatory rules.
•	Strong proficiency with cloud accounting platforms and advanced Excel for financial modelling and reconciliation.
•	CPA/CA qualified or currently undertaking professional accounting accreditation will highly regarded.
•	Strong knowledge of Australian taxation law and compliance requirements.
•	Clear written and verbal communication skills to deliver straightforward financial advice to non- 
financial business owners.
•	Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability.

Roles and Responsibility:
This is a senior level accounting service role, with core duties including:
?	Conduct payroll reviews fully compliant with ATO standards, including superannuation contribution calculations and salary packaging deduction audits.
?	Prepare month-end accounting deliverables: cash flow statements, journal entries, ad-hoc performance reports, monthly budgets, balance sheets and formal management reporting packs.
?	Prepare, reconcile and lodge all compliance documentation including Business Activity Statements (BAS), individual, company, partnership and super fund tax returns covering GST, PAYG instalments, PAYG withholding and all statutory tax obligations.
?	Design, update and refine internal financial workflows and general accounting procedures to boost operational efficiency and accuracy.
?	Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support for cloud-based accounting software systems used by internal teams and SME clients.
?	Compile complete financial statements (balance sheet, profit & loss, cash flow statements), conduct line-by-line account reviews and general ledger reconciliations, and deliver profitability, liquidity and financial health analysis to firm management and directors.
?	Prepare, validate and submit accurate annual Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) filings for all client entities.
?	Deliver customised professional taxation and structural advice to clients covering business setup,     
growth planning and daily operational financial optimisation.
?	Build robust financial control frameworks to protect client asset integrity, analyse operational expenses and track organisational income and expenditure trends.
?	Serve as the primary liaison for external auditors and support interim and year-end statutory audit procedures for all client portfolios.
?	Correspond and negotiate directly with the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) and other financial regulatory authorities as required for client compliance matters.
?	Identify legitimate tax minimisation opportunities, eligible claim deductions and profit-improvement strategies for individual and business clients.

result.description:
Lead Safety. Build Culture. Make a Real Difference.

Are you a passionate safety professional who knows that great safety outcomes are built on trust, influence and genuine engagement with people?

We are seeking an experienced Safety Manager to join a diverse and growing organisation based in Wangaratta, supporting a workforce of approximately 300 employees across multiple operational environments including manufacturing, warehousing and field-based technical services.

This is an opportunity to step into a highly visible leadership role where you will shape safety strategy, influence business performance and help create a workplace where everyone goes home safe every day.

About the Role

Reporting to senior leadership, you will lead and drive the Health, Safety and Wellbeing function across multiple sites and operational activities. You will develop, implement and continuously improve safety systems, ensuring compliance while fostering a practical, positive and people-focused safety culture.

You will be responsible for:

* Developing, implementing and managing the organisation's OHS Operational Plan
* Acting as the organisation's Return to Work (RTW) Coordinator
* Leading risk management activities, including hazard identification, risk assessments and controls
* Delivering and coordinating safety training, coaching and capability development
* Supporting managers and employees with task design, reasonable adjustments and injury prevention initiatives
* Facilitating meaningful consultation with employees, Health and Safety Representatives and key stakeholders
* Leading incident investigations using recognised methodologies such as ICAM, Root Cause Analysis and other contemporary investigation techniques
* Ensuring corrective actions are practical, effective and embedded into business operations
* Maintaining compliance with legislative, regulatory and reporting requirements
* Managing safety records, reporting systems and digital safety management tools
* Developing safety metrics, reporting insights and recommendations to support business decision-making
* Driving continuous improvement across all safety and wellbeing programs

About You

You are more than a compliance professional, you are a genuine leader who can connect with people, earn trust and positively influence behaviours at every level of an organisation.

You will bring:

Essential Requirements

* Minimum Certificate IV in Work Health & Safety or Occupational Health & Safety
* Demonstrated experience in a similar Safety Manager, Safety Advisor or Health & Safety leadership role within manufacturing, industrial, logistics, warehousing, technical services or a comparable operational environment
* Experience as a Return to Work Coordinator
* Strong capability in risk management, safety systems and operational safety leadership
* Proven experience leading complex incident investigations and implementing sustainable corrective actions
* Excellent knowledge of reporting procedures, record-keeping requirements and safety management systems
* Strong understanding and application of digital reporting and safety management platforms

Comprehensive knowledge of:
* Occupational Health and Safety Act 2004 (Victoria)
* Victorian OHS Regulations
* Relevant Australian Standards and industry best practice
* Current driver's licence

Personal Attributes
We are looking for someone who:

* Leads with authenticity, integrity and accountability
* Has an open, approachable and engaging communication style
* Can confidently influence and coach leaders, supervisors and frontline employees
* Builds strong relationships across all levels of the organisation and with external stakeholders
* Balances commercial understanding with a genuine commitment to safety and legal compliance
* Is highly organised, proactive and solutions-focused
* Thrives in a hands-on environment and enjoys being visible in the workplace rather than behind a desk

Why Join Us?

* Attractive $100K++ salary and benefits package
* Key leadership position with genuine influence across the organisation
* Diverse operational environment providing variety and challenge
* Opportunity to shape safety culture and drive meaningful change
* Work with a business that values people, safety and continuous improvement
* Enjoy the lifestyle benefits of living and working in beautiful regional Wangaratta

Ready to Lead the Way?

If you're a people-first safety professional with the experience, credibility and passion to create safer workplaces and stronger safety cultures, we'd love to hear from you.

Contact Dan Sawyer for a PD and more information in confidence on 0403 899143

Full-time Broker Group Information Management Coordinator position available in Cranbourne West VIC 3977

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Salary Range: $95,000 $105,000 per annum (exclusive superannuation)
•	Position based in Cranbourne West VIC 3977
•	Opportunity to contribute to the growth, structure and efficiency of a national broker network

Position Overview
finweb operates in the Australian mortgage broking and finance services sector as a broker group supporting mortgage brokers across Australia.

The business provides brokers with access to operational support, onboarding assistance, mentoring, business development resources, compliance coordination, in-house processing support, referral opportunities, CRM systems, workflow tools and practical business resources to help them manage and grow their broker businesses.

finweb is seeking a full-time Broker Group Information Management Coordinator to support the business by managing, analysing and reporting on operational information across broker onboarding, broker/member activity, referral pathways, CRM records, workflow systems, processing support, compliance-related administration and business development initiatives. The successful candidate will assist management by ensuring that operational information is accurately recorded, analysed, reported and used to support business decision-making, workflow efficiency, broker support visibility and organisational growth.

Position Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Analyse broker group operational information, including broker onboarding, CRM activity, referral pathways, workflow progress and processing support activity, to identify trends, delays, risks and improvement opportunities.
•	Maintain accurate business information across CRM systems, MyCRM, Trello, spreadsheets, onboarding trackers, broker registers and internal workflow tools.
•	Prepare operational reports, broker activity summaries, onboarding updates, referral reports, pipeline reports and management insights to support business planning and decision-making.
•	Monitor broker onboarding, accreditation, system access, referral tracking and internal workflow processes to identify stalled matters, missing information, handover issues and operational bottlenecks.
•	Develop and maintain reporting tools, workflow templates, onboarding trackers, broker support registers, checklists, process documents and information management procedures.
•	Review internal systems and workflow records to improve data accuracy, reporting structure, CRM visibility, handover quality and operational efficiency.
•	Support management with business information analysis relating to broker/member operations, referral performance, compliance administration, processing support activity and broker group growth initiatives.
•	Conduct research into mortgage broking market trends, broker group service offerings, aggregator support models, competitor positioning, broker recruitment activity and broker support practices to support business planning and operational development.
•	Maintain structured internal business information resources, including lender information, referral partner information, training materials, compliance resources, processing documentation and onboarding materials, to ensure business information remains accurate, accessible and consistently recorded.
•	Document, track and report broker communications, internal updates and operational information to ensure matters are properly recorded, monitored and escalated where appropriate.
•	Support the implementation of improved reporting, workflow tracking and information management practices across broker onboarding, broker support, processing assistance, referral tracking and member engagement.
•	Ensure all information management, broker communication and operational support activities remain within approved business, licensing and compliance boundaries, with credit advice, legal, licensing, commercial or complex matters escalated to appropriately authorised personnel.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	A bachelor degree or higher qualification in Business, Commerce, Finance, Management, Marketing, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Communications or a related field.
•	At least three years of relevant experience in business information management, operations analysis, CRM administration, pipeline reporting, stakeholder coordination, financial services support, broker support, member support, aggregator support, workflow coordination or operational reporting.
•	Experience using CRM systems, workflow management platforms, reporting tools, spreadsheets, business records, pipeline trackers or other business information systems.
•	Demonstrated ability to interpret operational information and prepare clear management reports, workflow summaries and business insights.
•	Ability to identify process gaps, information inconsistencies and workflow inefficiencies, and recommend practical operational improvements.
•	Knowledge of the Australian mortgage broking, lending, finance, aggregator or professional services sector is highly regarded.

Salary: This is a full-time position with competitive remuneration between $95,000 - $105,000 p.a. plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.
